Chat id, owner, whitelist, language and the upd"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"ate cursor live in the same `config.json`."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Below the whitelist, **Subagent messages** is a master switch for subagent-originated notifications."},{"id":"p30s2","text":" When it is on, **Completion messages** and **Questions** appear underneath; all three default to on"},{"id":"p30s3","text":". **Questions** also covers subagent approval prompts."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Whitelist"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The panel's **Whitelist** field accepts `@username`, `t.me/username`, `https://t.me/username`, `tg:/"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"/user?id=…` or a numeric id — separated by commas, spaces or newlines."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- **Empty whitelist** — the owner is assigned automatically: the first user who sends `/start` in a "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"private chat. Only the owner can write to the bot and press buttons.
- **Non-empty whitelist** — onl"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"y listed users can bind the chat, send messages and press buttons. Everyone else is rejected; their "},{"id":"p33s4","text":"button presses are ignored.
- The owner always has access, even when not listed.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"See the visual guide for the architecture diagram, the full sequence
and the screenshots."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The plugin subscribes to three seams:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"| Seam | Behaviour |"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"| `user-questions/request` (waterfall, prepended) | Sends the question to Telegram and waits for an "},{"id":"p38s2","text":"answer, while calling `next()` so the Web UI question stays available. |
| `approval/request` (water"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"fall, prepended) | Sends Allow / Deny buttons, while passing the request to the Web UI. |
| `session"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"/event` (`turn/end`) | Builds the summary for the finished turn. |"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Sub-agent sessions (`session.header.origin === 'subagent'`) are forwarded by default. The panel's **"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"Subagent messages** switch is the master control; once it is on, **Completion messages** and **Quest"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"ions** choose what is sent. The Questions checkbox also covers subagent approval prompts, because an"},{"id":"p39s4","text":" approval is an interactive subagent question. All three default to **on**. Turning the master switc"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"h off keeps the two nested choices for later; it does not erase them."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Telegram transport is **long polling** (`getUpdates`), so no public IP, webhook or TLS certificate i"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"s needed. The loopback HTTP server only serves the control panel and is protected by a per-process C"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"The loopback HTTP server only serves the control panel and is protected by a per-process CSRF token."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"Markdown in the assistant's final text is rendered into Telegram HTML: bold, italic, strikethrough, "},{"id":"p41s2","text":"inline code, fenced code blocks, links, quotes, headings and `||spoilers||`. The folder/time/tool li"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"ne always goes last."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"## Security notes"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"- The panel binds `127.0.0.1` only. Any local process can still reach it; do not expose the port to "},{"id":"p43s2","text":"a network.
- The bot token grants full control over the bot. Never share it or put it in a repositor"},{"id":"p43s3","text":"y.
- Only the bound chat receives notifications. In a group, every member can read them.
- Question "},{"id":"p43s4","text":"and approval text is sent to Telegram's servers; attachments and file contents are never uploaded."}],"truncated":true}
